about.citationMethod: Every step in every trophy's guide carries the name of the source it rests on, shown as a chip beside the step. Each trophy also lists its sources in full, with links, under its steps. The official trophy names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's own words, reproduced exactly; everything else in this ledger is written for this app, in our own words, from the sources named. A step with no source would earn no credit — so there are none.
about.title: LEONIDA LEDGER — GTA VI trophy guide & tracker

roadmap.summary: Play the campaign straight through. All 12 story trophies unlock along the way, the map and every activity type open up, and world progress already counts toward the 100% checklist even before you can see it. Two habits to build now: scan every new vehicle model you pass, and never enter a cheat on a trophy run — cheats disable trophies and saving for the session.
tips: When Chapter 1 offers the meditation at Jason's house, take it — it belongs to the game's one missable trophy (Phase 2).
Keep a manual save before the final mission; there is free roam afterwards, but no mission replay.
Bank activity first-tries as they appear — Master of None rewards sampling all 9 activity types.
roadmap.title: Phase 1 — Story First: Chapters 1–4 and the Finale

roadmap.summary: Exactly one trophy on this list can be lost: of the 18 meditation spots, the first is offered during Chapter 1 at Jason's house and cannot be revisited the same way afterwards, and the game has no mission replay. If you took it in Phase 1, this phase is a relaxed free-roam sweep of the other 17. If you are already past Chapter 1 without it, nothing else matters until a fresh playthrough banks it — everything else on the list can wait, this one cannot.
tips: Meditate at every prompt the story offers, not just in Chapter 1.
The other 17 spots never expire — only the Chapter 1 spot is time-critical.
roadmap.title: Phase 2 — The One Missable: Positive Mental Attitude

roadmap.summary: With the map fully open, sweep the collection trophies: explore all 52 areas of Leonida, discover 100 vehicles, complete 3 Collectible Card sets and WAiNK It at 100 locations. These overlap heavily — one road trip per district advances all four at once, and exploration keeps surfacing stunt spots and race markers for Phase 4.
tips: There are 18 card sets: the trophy needs 3 completed, but the 100% checklist wants 15 — finish sets, don't scatter.
The vehicle trophy asks for 100 discoveries; the checklist wants 200 of 277 models, so keep scanning after this phase ends.
roadmap.title: Phase 3 — The Open-World Sweep: Collectibles & Exploration

roadmap.summary: Work the activity grinds: gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, wins at all 14 Top Fun drone locations, 20 different race wins, 250 of the 397 stunts and 50 challenges. Then finish the people: 8 stranger strands and the six character strands — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret — which sit outside the 100% checklist entirely and are the easiest trophies on the list to forget.
tips: Stranger and character strands don't feed the 100% checklist — schedule them deliberately.
Challenges (One Last Thing) accumulate while you grind everything else in this phase.
roadmap.title: Phase 4 — Activities, Ranges, Races & Strangers

roadmap.summary: The misc shelf: partner crimes (lose a 4-star level together, rob 3 shops back-to-back), clean crimes (an unseen jewelry robbery, 5 bank vaults, an armored truck, one illegal operation per gang — all 9 of them), set pieces (a Rhino, an unscheduled VCIA departure, a showroom exit through the glass) and the money trophies: $250,000 laundered, $100,000 spent, all 8 garage properties bought, 10 vehicles registered with Scooter Bros.
tips: Robbery trophies feed Dime on the Dollar — launder the marked bills as they come in.
Do the two partner trophies in one session while you have the wanted-level rhythm down.
roadmap.title: Phase 5 — Feats, Fortune & Free-Roam Chaos

roadmap.summary: Whatever the checklist still owes, finish it: A Long Road is the difference between a story completion and a platinum. When the counter reads 100% and every other entry in this ledger is ticked, Vice Got a Price! is awarded automatically — the platinum needs no step of its own.
tips: Audit the checklist against this tracker phase by phase; the last percent is usually a collectible count, not a feat.
PowerPyx's roughly 200-hour estimate for the full list assumes this phase is worked steadily, not saved for one sitting.
roadmap.title: Phase 6 — The 100% Push and the Platinum
